-- ── GlobalStrings this page uses (ref-GlobalStrings.lua, cited per line — the -- `X = X or "..."` idiom is this codebase's convention: the real localized file, loaded off -- the patch chain first, always wins; these fill in for the test harnesses, which load no -- chain. Redeclared here rather than leaned on from CharacterFrame.xml so a subset load of -- this file alone still resolves.) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ATTACK_COLON = ATTACK_COLON or "Attack:" -- :70 DAMAGE_COLON = DAMAGE_COLON or "Damage:" -- :888 ATTACK_POWER_COLON = ATTACK_POWER_COLON or "Power:" -- :71 DEFENSE_COLON = DEFENSE_COLON or "Defense:" -- :917 ARMOR_COLON = ARMOR_COLON or "Armor:" -- :63 ATTACK_TOOLTIP = ATTACK_TOOLTIP or "Attack Rating" -- :75 DEFENSE_TOOLTIP = DEFENSE_TOOLTIP or "Defense Rating" -- :918 TRAINING_POINTS = TRAINING_POINTS or "Training Points:" -- :4305 UNIT_LEVEL_TEMPLATE = UNIT_LEVEL_TEMPLATE or "Level %d" -- :4436 PET_DIET_TEMPLATE = PET_DIET_TEMPLATE or "Diet: %s" -- :3037
BENILLA_NUM_PET_STATS = 5 -- NUM_PET_STATS (ref l.2) BENILLA_NUM_PET_RESISTANCE_TYPES = 5 -- NUM_PET_RESISTANCE_TYPES (ref l.1)
-- ── The page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- ref PetPaperDollFrame_OnLoad (l.4-29). The five labels live ONLY in the row template's -- $parentLabel and Lua fills them — never a re-declared region in an instance (the sibling -- page's OnLoad carries the why: this engine's template expansion APPENDS children, so a -- re-declared $parentLabel makes a second anchorless FontString instead of merging). -- `SetTextStatusBarTextPrefix(…, XP)` is dropped with the bar's numerals (header). function PetPaperDollFrame_OnLoad() local frame = this getglobal("PetAttackFrameLabel"):SetText(ATTACK_COLON) getglobal("PetDamageFrameLabel"):SetText(DAMAGE_COLON) getglobal("PetAttackPowerFrameLabel"):SetText(ATTACK_POWER_COLON) getglobal("PetDefenseFrameLabel"):SetText(DEFENSE_COLON) getglobal("PetArmorFrameLabel"):SetText(ARMOR_COLON) frame:RegisterEvent("PET_UI_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("PET_BAR_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("PET_UI_CLOSE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_PET") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_PET_EXPERIENCE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_MODEL_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_LEVEL") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_RESISTANCES") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_STATS") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_DAMAGE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_RANGEDDAMAGE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_ATTACK_SPEED") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_ATTACK_POWER") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_DEFENSE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_ATTACK") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_PET_TRAINING_POINTS") PetTab_Update() end
-- ref PetPaperDollFrame_OnEvent (l.31-48), all four arms. NOTE the shape: unlike the -- character page, this one does NOT gate on visibility — the first arm has to run while the -- page is HIDDEN, because that is what keeps the tab itself in step with whether a pet -- exists. Only the last arm (a plain "the pet's numbers moved") is unit-token gated. function PetPaperDollFrame_OnEvent() local frame = this if event == "PET_UI_UPDATE" or event == "PET_BAR_UPDATE" or (event == "UNIT_PET" and arg1 == "player") then -- The pet left while its own page was open: close the window (ToggleCharacter on -- the visible page is the ref's own way of saying HideUIPanel), then re-fit the tab. if frame:IsVisible() and not HasPetUI() then ToggleCharacter("PetPaperDollFrame") end PetTab_Update() PetPaperDollFrame_Update() elseif event == "PET_UI_CLOSE" then if frame:IsVisible() then ToggleCharacter("PetPaperDollFrame") end PetTab_Update() elseif event == "UNIT_PET_EXPERIENCE" then PetExpBar_Update() elseif arg1 == "pet" then PetPaperDollFrame_Update() end end
-- ref PetPaperDollFrame_OnShow/_OnHide (l.50-60): the window's ONE name line is shared — -- the pet page borrows it and puts the player's back on the way out. function PetPaperDollFrame_OnShow() getglobal("CharacterNameText"):Hide() local petName = getglobal("PetNameText") petName:Show() petName:SetText(UnitName("pet")) PetPaperDollFrame_Update() end
function PetPaperDollFrame_OnHide() getglobal("CharacterNameText"):Show() getglobal("PetNameText"):Hide() end
-- ref PetPaperDollFrame_Update (l.62-94). The `hasPetUI` early-out is load-bearing, not -- defensive: every setter below reads the "pet" token, and with no pet those all answer the -- absent shape — repainting from it would blank a page the ref leaves showing its last state -- until the tab itself goes. function PetPaperDollFrame_Update() local hasPetUI, canGainXP = HasPetUI() if not hasPetUI then return end -- ref l.67 `PetModelFrame:SetUnit("pet")` — no analogue: the app's `petdoll` booth -- resolves the pet itself (header). -- -- The ref's own `if ( UnitCreatureFamily("pet") ) then` guard, kept (decision 1062): -- nil is genuinely reachable — no family on the template, or the creature query that -- carries the family id has not answered yet — and the reference's answer is a BLANK -- level line rather than a bare "Level 58". Hoisted to a local because the ref calls -- the binding twice for one answer. local family = UnitCreatureFamily("pet") if family then getglobal("PetLevelText"):SetText( format(UNIT_LEVEL_TEMPLATE, UnitLevel("pet")) .. " " .. family) end getglobal("PetLoyaltyText"):SetText(GetPetLoyalty()) PetExpBar_Update() PetPaperDollFrame_SetResistances() PetPaperDollFrame_SetStats() PaperDollFrame_SetDamage("pet", "Pet") PaperDollFrame_SetRangedDamage("pet", "Pet") PaperDollFrame_SetAttackPower("pet", "Pet") PaperDollFrame_SetRangedAttackPower("pet", "Pet") PaperDollFrame_SetArmor("pet", "Pet") PaperDollFrame_SetAttackBothHands("pet", "Pet") PaperDollFrame_SetDefense("pet", "Pet")
-- The hunter-only block (ref l.83-93): the diet icon and the training-point line are -- the two things a warlock's minion never has. `canGainXP` is HasPetUI's second return. if canGainXP then getglobal("PetPaperDollPetInfo"):Show() local totalPoints, spent = GetPetTrainingPoints() local text = getglobal("PetTrainingPointText") text:SetText(totalPoints - spent) text:Show() getglobal("PetTrainingPointLabel"):Show() else getglobal("PetPaperDollPetInfo"):Hide() getglobal("PetTrainingPointText"):Hide() getglobal("PetTrainingPointLabel"):Hide() end end
-- ref PetPaperDollFrame_SetResistances (l.96-137). Deliberately NOT the character page's -- version: the pet's has no resistance-quality subtext (no `RESISTANCE_TOOLTIP_SUBTEXT` -- line at all) and colours the NUMBER off its own sign rather than off pos-vs-neg -- magnitude — two real differences in the reference, transcribed rather than unified. function PetPaperDollFrame_SetResistances() for i = 1, BENILLA_NUM_PET_RESISTANCE_TYPES do local resistId = BENILLA_MAGICRES_IDS[i] local text = getglobal("PetMagicResText" .. i) local frame = getglobal("PetMagicResFrame" .. i) local base, resistance, positive, negative = UnitResistance("pet", resistId) frame.tooltip = getglobal("RESISTANCE" .. resistId .. "_NAME") -- Resistances can be negative: red below zero, green above, plain white at zero. if resistance < 0 then text:SetText(RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. resistance .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) elseif resistance == 0 then text:SetText(resistance) else text:SetText(GREEN_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. resistance .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) end if positive ~= 0 or negative ~= 0 then frame.tooltip = frame.tooltip .. " ( " .. HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. base if positive > 0 then frame.tooltip = frame.tooltip .. GREEN_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. " +" .. positive end if negative < 0 then frame.tooltip = frame.tooltip .. " " .. RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. negative end frame.tooltip = frame.tooltip .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE .. " )" end end end
-- ref PetPaperDollFrame_SetStats (l.139-181) — byte-for-byte the character page's -- _SetStats with the pet's own frame names and the "pet" token (the ref carries the same -- duplication; unifying them would mean inventing a prefix the reference's own -- `PetStatFrame`/`CharacterStatFrame` naming doesn't share). function PetPaperDollFrame_SetStats() for i = 1, BENILLA_NUM_PET_STATS do local label = getglobal("PetStatFrame" .. i .. "Label") local text = getglobal("PetStatFrame" .. i .. "StatText") local frame = getglobal("PetStatFrame" .. i) local statName = getglobal("SPELL_STAT" .. (i - 1) .. "_NAME") label:SetText(statName .. ":") local stat, effectiveStat, posBuff, negBuff = UnitStat("pet", i) local tooltipText = HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. statName .. " " if posBuff == 0 and negBuff == 0 then text:SetText(effectiveStat) frame.tooltip = tooltipText .. effectiveStat .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE else tooltipText = tooltipText .. effectiveStat if posBuff > 0 or negBuff < 0 then tooltipText = tooltipText .. " (" .. (stat - posBuff - negBuff) .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end if posBuff > 0 then tooltipText = tooltipText .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE .. GREEN_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. "+" .. posBuff .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end if negBuff < 0 then tooltipText = tooltipText .. RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. " " .. negBuff .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end if posBuff > 0 or negBuff < 0 then tooltipText = tooltipText .. HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. ")" .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end frame.tooltip = tooltipText if negBuff < 0 then text:SetText(RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. effectiveStat .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) else text:SetText(GREEN_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. effectiveStat .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) end end end end
-- ref PetExpBar_Update (l.183-187). `min(0, currXP)` is the ref's own; XP can't be negative, -- so it is just 0 — quoted, not simplified. function PetExpBar_Update() local currXP, nextXP = GetPetExperience() local bar = getglobal("PetPaperDollFrameExpBar") bar:SetMinMaxValues(math.min(0, currXP), nextXP) bar:SetValue(currXP) end
-- ref PetTab_Update (l.189-198) — the conditional tab, whole. The re-anchor is what keeps -- the row gapless: with tab 2 hidden, tab 3 sits at tab 2's own LEFT (i.e. exactly where -- tab 2 would have started) instead of -16 past its RIGHT. function PetTab_Update() local tab2 = getglobal("CharacterFrameTab2") local tab3 = getglobal("CharacterFrameTab3") -- Nil-guarded like CharacterFrame_ShowSubFrame's own loop: a test subset may load this -- file without the window's tab row. if not tab2 or not tab3 then return end if not HasPetUI() then tab2:Hide() tab3:SetPoint("LEFT", "CharacterFrameTab2", "LEFT", 0, 0) else tab2:Show() tab3:SetPoint("LEFT", "CharacterFrameTab2", "RIGHT", -16, 0) end end

Scripts.OnEnter: -- ref l.267-270, unguarded now that both halves exist (decision 1062): -- `GetPetFoodTypes` is a real binding and `BuildListString` is the ref's -- own UIParent.lua joiner, transcribed in UIParent.xml. -- -- `BuildListString()` returns NIL on an empty list and `format`'s "%s" -- would error on it, so the pairing matters. Two things keep it safe, and -- both are the reference's: this frame is shown for HUNTER pets only (the -- `canGainXP` block above), and in the shipped `CreatureFamily.dbc` every -- family with a ZERO food mask is a warlock minion or "Remote Control" — -- every hunter-tameable family has a real diet. `GetPetFoodTypes` is -- itself hunter-gated in the binary too (`0x6116e0`), so all three agree. GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(format(PET_DIET_TEMPLATE, BuildListString(GetPetFoodTypes()))) GameTooltip:Show()

GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(self.tooltip) GameTooltip:AddLine(self.tooltipSubtext, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b, 1) GameTooltip:Show()

GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(self.tooltip) GameTooltip:AddLine(self.tooltipSubtext, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b, 1) GameTooltip:Show()
